newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 9.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* Walt Disney's Buena Vista TV has sold its new late night show with Keenen Ivory Wayans to the combined 22-station Fox-New World group for an August debut.
* 16-year-old Natalie Portman is in discussions with George Lucas to co-star as Princess Leia's mother at a younger age in the first Star Wars prequel.
* Negotiations are under way with Tim Burton to direct Time Warner Warner Bros.' Superman, with Nicolas Cage starring in what could become another major franchise for the studio, sources said.
* Tele-Communications Inc has finalized a series of carriage agreements with Disney-owned cable subsidiaries ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNews and the Disney Channel.

* Andrew Bergman has committed to his next two directing projects for Universal Pictures. He is scheduled to direct the black comedy "Intolerable Cruelty" in the fall, to be followed by the comedy "Jet Lag" in the summer.
* Charlize Theron, who just starred in Devil's Advocate at Warner Bros., is in final negotiations for the lead in Disney's planned offering Mighty Joe Young.
* Epic Records has signed a five-year pact with Happy Walters' Immortal Entertainment to enhance Epic's West Coast profile and create a label where music and film projects converge under one banner.
